_comment_profile: This file is intentionally loadable by Experiment03. The loader ignores unknown keys, so `_comment_*` fields act as inline documentation.
_comment_usage: Start with this profile for readable experiments, then edit only the profile fields relevant to the sweep you are running.
_comment_step_1: Smoke-test the full pipeline first: keep epochs low and cap batches so you can validate shapes, I/O, and logging quickly.
_comment_step_2: For real training, increase `training_epochs`, increase `training_batch_size` if RAM allows, and set `training_max_batches_per_epoch` to 0 to consume the full dataset.
_comment_step_3: Window sizes affect the input dimensionality. If you change window sizes, leave feature overrides at 0 unless you have a specific reason to force dimensions.
_comment_step_4: The prefetcher overlaps I/O with training. Increase `program_prefetch_lookahead` gradually; reduce it again when debugging data integrity or memory pressure.
_comment_step_5: For deterministic comparisons, keep `sampler_shuffle_seed` fixed and record the exact profile values used for each run.
_comment_training_mode: Suggested escalation: update this profile (e.g. set `training_epochs = 10`, `training_max_batches_per_epoch = 0`, `training_batch_size = 128`) once the smoke run is stable.
_comment_snn_mode: To adapt this to SNN, change `neural_network_type` to `fused-window-snn` and start by tuning time-step, resistance, and capacitance conservatively.
